rules.name: Mandatory retreat route
rules.description: Every engaged unit must have at least one valid, vehicle-compatible retreat route at all times.

rules.name: Vehicle/road compatibility
rules.description: A unit may only be routed on roads compatible with its vehicle type, taking current restrictions into account.

rules.name: Minimum water threshold
rules.description: A CCF must not remain engaged in suppression below 20% water; below 35% a refill plan is required.

rules.name: Visibility constraint
rules.description: No unit may be tasked to operate offensively in near-zero visibility; reassess mission and consider withdrawal.

rules.name: Hazardous material exclusion perimeter
rules.description: Confirmed or suspected hazardous materials (e.g. gas cylinders) require an exclusion perimeter; no unit enters until assessment.

rules.name: No dispatch without human approval
rules.description: No dispatch instruction may be sent to any unit without explicit approval of the human incident commander.
